design: L229 near-balance as a POPULATION question (static): per-pool-side inhibitory in-mass fraction for ALL TEN cord pool-sides (Ti/Tr/Ta/Sr/Pr x L/R) against each pool-side's dynamic range over the stored arms, with an EXACT n=10 membership-permutation null. Zero rollouts, zero dynamics.

limits: One connectome (BANC v626 female cord), one operating-point family, pool MEANS only (per-cell ceiling fraction is not recoverable from stored traces — L208's declared limit), TEN units, and the six new pool-sides are 7-19 cells against Ti/Tr's 55-57. inh_frac is an ANATOMICAL in-mass ratio under the log1p ladder convention, not a measured E/I current balance. Correlation over ten pool-sides with an exact null is a population DESCRIPTION, not causality in either direction. L215's four Ti/Tr inh_frac values and three of l208's Ti lvl values were READ while scoping and are declared DESCRIPTION in PREREG 0h; every branch sits on unobserved quantities.
